state.instructions: Judging from this local branch's commit subjects, the days since its last commit, its unpushed commits and the repository's open pull request titles, what state is the branch in?

criteria.WIP: work in progress: the commits describe an unfinished change that is still being worked on
criteria.abandoned: work that was started and then left: old, unfinished, and nothing suggests it will continue
criteria.ready for PR: the commits describe a finished, coherent change that could be opened as a pull request now
criteria.spike: an exploratory experiment or prototype (spike, try, poc, hack, experiment) not meant to be merged as is
criteria.superseded: one of the open pull requests already does the same change, so this branch is no longer needed
